title: PackDryRunSampleRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the PackDryRunSampleRecorded platform event (owner ruling INV-Q-4870 B, names pinned by INV-Q-5194; INV-REQ-772 b1, INV-REQ-1303; class: platform): one page of the dry-run sample. The documents array holds at most 500 documents: API-42 limits an event to 1 MB, and 500 documents are at most 148,500 bytes at this schema's maximum string lengths, so a full page stays far below 1 MB. The tenant is the envelope attribute tenantid (API-40). The optional sgdValuesAbsent flag on a document is true only for a document in a foreign currency that has no stated SGD totals (INV-Q-5634 A). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

dryRunId.description: The dry run the page belongs to.

lastPage.description: True on the last page of the sample.

entityRef.description: The entity the document belongs to.

internalTaxCode.description: The internal tax code of the document.

supplyType.description: The GST supply type of the document (INV-Q-10703 option B'). Equals the value of canonicalDocument.supplyType of the document's current canonical version. A consumer treats an item without it as having no stated supply type.

precedingDocumentDate.description: Date of the preceding document; credit notes only.

taxableValue.description: Signed taxable value as a decimal string (API-12).

gstValue.description: Signed GST value as a decimal string (API-12).

sgdValuesAbsent.description: True only for a document in a foreign currency that has no stated SGD totals; taxableValue and gstValue are then the placeholder 0.00, a consumer leaves such an item out of every total and shows it as absent, and a value is never converted (INV-Q-5568 A, INV-Q-5634 A). Absent or false means the values are real.

documents.description: The documents of the page; at most 500 (API-42, 1 MB event limit; see the schema description).
